notes: One warmup, then repeated transforms in a fresh process per case.
CPU is local Node process CPU, not Cloudflare CPU.
WASM capacity is high-water linear-memory capacity, not live heap or whole-process memory.
Reference and scanline cases match quality, scaling and WebP encoder settings. JPEG has no legacy encoder baseline.
rowStorageEstimateBytes excludes coefficients, codec-internal buffers, input, encoded output and the WebP destination.
